summary: __thiscall constructor for an audio stream object: installs the generic constructor base, assigns the audio stream vtable off_5B8B3C to the object, zeroes a WORD at +0x12C and a DWORD at +0x130, then runs the small-struct field initializer over the object. Returns the this pointer.

operations.description: Run the generic constructor prologue ConstructorVTableSetInit over the object to initialize base fields.
Install the audio stream vtable off_5B8B3C into the vtable slot at this+0x0.
Zero the WORD-sized field at this+0x12C (offset 300); possibly stream state or flags.
Zero the DWORD-sized field at this+0x130 (offset 304); possibly buffer size or timer.
Call SmallStructFieldInit over the object to initialize additional small-struct fields to zero/defaults.

unresolved: The global 0x0059CBC8 (SEH_581E80) is a compiler-generated exception-handler registration and does not appear in the visible function body.
Semantics of the zeroed fields at +0x12C and +0x130 depend on the audio stream object layout, which is not established here.
